name: CamRequestFlags
meaning: Bits of g_camReqFlags 0x6e45be, set by Wolf_UpdateCamera / Robot_UpdateCamera (reset value 0x10)

name: CAMREQ_LEDGE_PROBE
meaning: Camera_ProbeLedgeAhead may fire (Wolf state flag 0x10 and not Wolf flags_ 0x20)

name: CAMREQ_SNAP_YAW
meaning: Wolf flags_ 0x400: yaw snaps to 90-degree steps with edge-triggered camL/camR, and cuts are disabled (the solver's local_54 = 0)

name: CAMREQ_PAD_ROTATE
meaning: mode 5: player may turn the camera

name: CAMREQ_RESTRICT
meaning: mode 5: apply g_camRestriction and its trajectory
